caption: The model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Activated Parameters Ratio and the Eval PPL for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” and is a linear scale ranging from 100 to 25, with tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and is a linear scale ranging from 12.0 to 14.0. A dashed orange line, labeled “Transformer”, begins at a value of 11.6 when the Activated Parameters Ratio is 100, and increases to a value of 12.8 when the Activated Parameters Ratio is 25. A solid gray line, labeled "Only MoHD FFN", starts at 12.2 when the Activated Parameters Ratio is 100, and rises to 12.8 when the Activated Parameters Ratio is 25. A solid dark blue line, labeled “Only MoHD ATTN”, begins at a value of 12.1 at the Activated Parameters Ratio of 100, increasing to 13.3 at the Activated Parameters Ratio of 25. Finally, a solid cyan line, labeled "MoHD ATTN + MLP", starts at 11.7 when the Activated Parameters Ratio is 100, increases to 13.2 when the Activated Parameters Ratio is 25.
